messages:
Devon: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered 'staircase' canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Steps: 0.5% -> 2% -> 7% -> 20% with ~30m holds. I will own the deploy; @Mike will trigger, @Sara runs smoke, @Priya is oncall/watch. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% absolute or p50 latency +50ms sustained for 10m. Exclude enterprise tenants (SLA tag) and internal billing accounts. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/staircase-canary (see checklist).

Mike: On it — I'll be at my laptop at 05:50 UTC. Which pipeline/job do I run?

Devon: Use pipeline `infra/canary/staircase-v2`, job name `canary-rollout-job`. Short command to kick: `rwdctl pipeline run infra/canary/staircase-v2 --job canary-rollout-job --env prod`

Sara: Smoke checklist I'll follow:
- quick health (/health)
- sample gen against model variant (small prompt)
- embeddings sanity for a couple keys
- check GPU mem / OOM logs
- tail error logs for first 5 min of each step
I'll paste outputs here.

Sara: Quick smoke command I use (copy/paste):
```
# sample text gen smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD_TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"model":"staircase-v2-canary","input":"Summarize the following in two bullets: Redwood inference platform."}' | jq .
```

Jamal: Metrics to watch during holds: p50/p95 latency, error rate (4xx/5xx), request volume deviation, GPU util, KV cache miss rate. Also watch for sudden tail latencies in the reranker path. If p95 > baseline + 200ms or error rate > 0.5%, escalate.

Alex: Cohort selection question: are we seeding with internal + opt-in only, or pulling a random fraction of general traffic?

Devon: Plan is internal + opt-in users for 0.5% and 2% steps. At 7% we open to a sampled fraction of free-tier non-SLA customers, still excluding enterprise. Cohort tags: `canary-opt-in`, `internal-beta`. Geo split NA/EU roughly even.

Priya: I have alert thresholds set for this rollout window. If error rate crosses threshold I will page `eng-oncall`. My esc policy: 5m sustained breach -> pager.

Mike: Noted. I'll start the pipeline and stay ready to rollback triggers. How do we rollback quickly if needed?

Devon: Two fast rollback actions: 1) `rwdctl traffic shift --model staircase-v2-canary --to previous --immediate` (preferred) 2) pipeline rollback `rwdctl pipeline rollback --job canary-rollout-job` (if we need to undo infra changes). Also we have traffic routing shortcut in Console: Model -> Rollback -> Route back.

Sara: I'll post smoke logs after each hold. I'll run the sample prompt and a short prompt set (5 quick prompts) and paste timing / errors.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline created: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/infra/canary/staircase-v2 (job canary-rollout-job). Scheduled start: 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z.

Mike: Thanks — I'll kick at 06:00 UTC and update this thread on each step start/complete. Tagging @eng-oncall and @product for visibility.

Devon: :thumbsup: I'll update release notes and the staging validation doc. If anyone wants to add canary prompts or specific customers to exclude, drop them here before 05:30 UTC.
